data.title: Prepare creative controls and inputs foundation for independent review
data.body: Read roadmap workstream3/milestones0.3/4 and detailed runtime/Studio/project/component contracts, inspect integrated code and active two-lane interfaces. Produce tracked docs/implementation/creative-inputs-plan.md with whole-lane ordered slices and a concrete first CPU-testable independent patch/test plan, exact owned files, control authority/timing/replay boundaries and versioned shared interfaces. Cover audio/MIDI reactivity, modulation, named looks/macros and persistence prerequisites without prematurely implementing all. Map each acceptance criterion to setup, method, expected observation, executor/role and eventual artifact source. Propose routine product decisions based on documents, noting evidence; preserve existing numeric controls and optional intensity. Explicitly protect C02 shared visual-worker/runtime-contracts and filesystem persistence owners. Independent plan critique by fresh reviewer required before implementation dispatch. This ticket is planning/code investigation only: no application code changes, graphics, merge or push. Deliver reviewed plan commit and next leaf ticket proposal to root; user authorized autonomy while sleeping.
